critical_code_review_comments: OTP_STORE is in-memory dict; multi-worker deployments (gunicorn>1 worker) would break OTP verification. Fine for single-process supervisor setup used here.
submissions.json is read/written on every request under a single asyncio.Lock — this will not scale beyond low volume but is documented as MVP local-JSON storage.
verify-otp does not distinguish 'not requested' from 'wrong code' (both -> 401 invalid). Acceptable for security (no user enumeration).

AI insight streaming persists full text via update_submission at StreamDone; if client disconnects mid-stream the persisted ai_insight will be truncated. Consider using request.is_disconnected checks.
In Submit.jsx the `region` field is sent from client but ignored in scoring (server calls _derive_region); harmless but confusing — either use it or remove from payload.
